        s = 0

            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][r[0]] + matrix[r[-1]][depot]

            c += matrix[r[i]][r[i + 1]]
        return c

        # ra and rb are lists without depot; merge only if ra end connects to rb start (and optionally reverse)

            return None
        if route_load(ra) + route_load(rb) > capacity:
            return None
        if a_end_to_b_start:
            return ra + rb
        else:
            return ra + rb[::-1]

        # deterministic: just return r or reversed based on smaller cost
        if not r or len(r) == 1:
            return r
        c1 = matrix[depot][r[0]] + matrix[r[-1]][depot]
        c2 = matrix[depot][r[-1]] + matrix[r[0]][depot]
        # full internal cost needs include edges; compute exactly
        def cost_of(x):
            c = matrix[depot][x[0]] + matrix[x[-1]][depot]
            for i in range(len(x) - 1):
                c += matrix[x[i]][x[i + 1]]
            return c
        if cost_of(r) <= cost_of(r[::-1]):
            return r
        return r[::-1]

                        new = matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]

                                routes[rid] = nr
